stem: A new spectrum increases stem elongation in one cultivar but not another while PPFD and photoperiod are unchanged. What is the strongest interpretation?
choices: Spectrum effects are universal and the second cultivar is defective
Spectrum can alter morphology, but response can be genotype-dependent and should be validated with measured architecture and performance
PPFD no longer matters when spectrum changes
Only nutrient concentration can explain the difference
rationale: Cannabis photobiology depends on spectrum, photon quantity, timing, genotype and canopy context. Spectral response should not be universalized from one cultivar.
